description:
Marble is a private workout journal built for fast logging, focused training, and clear progress.

Record weights, reps, distance, time, RPE, rest, notes, bodyweight, and supplements without an account, ads, or tracking. Your core data stays on your iPhone or iPad.

ADD A WORKOUT IN YOUR OWN WORDS
- Paste or type natural language, gym notation, multi-day Notes, or a Hevy or Strong CSV
- Let Apple Intelligence structure prose on device when available
- Review every workout, exercise match, set, date, RPE, rest, and note before saving
- Keep working with deterministic on-device parsing for notation and file imports

LOG WITHOUT LOSING YOUR FLOW
- Repeat your last set or use Save + Next for quick logging
- See personal-record targets while you enter a set
- Start and finish focused workout sessions
- Build weekly splits and reusable sprint prescriptions
- Track rest with an in-app timer, Live Activity, Dynamic Island, and rest-complete alert

UNDERSTAND YOUR PROGRESS
- See weekly goals, estimated 1RM, personal records, and training consistency
- Review Daily Highlights: a private evening recap of truthful same-day progress
- Track bodyweight manually or import it from Apple Health, and correct a weigh-in if a number was wrong
- Compare strength relative to bodyweight with a per-lift DOTS score
- Explore muscle-group, rep-range, effort, supplement, and calendar views

REACH MARBLE FROM iOS
- Add the Weekly Goal widget to your Home Screen or Lock Screen
- Log a set, repeat your last set, and start or finish workouts with Siri and Shortcuts
- Find exercises through Spotlight
- Open quick logging from Control Center, the Lock Screen, or the Action button

BRING IN MORE WORKOUTS
- Import Apple Health and Apple Watch workouts
- Bring Garmin workouts through Apple Health
- Scan handwritten workouts with on-device text recognition and review before saving
- Optionally send completed strength sessions to Apple Health

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
- Export and restore a portable JSON backup of your persisted training data
- Progress photos and videos remain on your device and are not included in backup files
- No account, Marble server, advertising, or third-party tracking

Just your training, clearly recorded and clearly understood.
promotionalText: New in 2.4: paste or type a workout in your own words, review the structured sets, and save only when everything looks right.
whatsNew:
Marble 2.4 makes adding a workout radically simpler.

NEW
- Add is now an AI-first workout composer: paste or type natural language, gym notation, multi-day Notes, or a Hevy or Strong CSV.
- Apple Intelligence structures prose on device when available; a deterministic parser handles notation and provides the fallback.
- Review every workout, exercise match, set, date, RPE, rest, and note before anything is saved.
- Drafts survive tab switches and relaunches, and Shortcuts can hand text directly to Add.

IMPROVED
- Strong exports handle European delimiters, decimal commas, kilograms, distance units, and supersets more accurately.
- Hevy imports preserve failed sets, RPE, notes, and session timing while skipping warmups.
- Weak exercise-name matches default to a new exercise instead of silently merging with the wrong movement.

Parsing and review stay on-device. Marble remains local-first: no account, no ads, no Marble server, and no third-party tracking.
